hero.h1: Exterior Remodeling Company in Wichita, KS — Evolve Exteriors
hero.sub: We're Colton and Riley. We replace windows, put up vinyl siding and install sliding patio doors, with the products and guarantees of the big companies and the owners close enough to look at your house ourselves. Call for a free estimate.

sections.quote: We have been hesitant due to the sky high pricing of a lot of companies around Wichita, until we were told about Evolve Exteriors. We met with Colton, who sold us the windows at a great price and they were here within about a month and a half's time and at our house a few days after that. … Colton came by to make sure everything was to our liking and, overall, I'm very happy with the finished product and how much cooler our house feels!
sections.name: Reagan P.

sections.heading: Big-Company Products, Owners on the Job
body: The outside of your house is one system. Windows, siding, doors and trim all meet at the same edges.
A leak or a draft at one shows up as a problem at the others. That's why we do all of it, and why one of us comes out to look before anyone quotes a price.
We don't spend on big ad campaigns, so that cost stays out of your price.
You get a real look at what's wrong and a price with no pressure to sign that day. Do the whole exterior at once, or one project at a time.
And because we're a small company, the people who quote your job are the people you call if anything isn't right.

image.alt: Front porch of a Wichita bungalow with new windows beside the door
image.brief: bungalow front porch with new windows beside the front door, house on the right, porch steps leading to the left, soft overcast sky behind the text side, no readable text, no people

sections.heading: Replacement Windows
body: Most of our work is windows. People usually call us because of a room that never gets comfortable, curtains that move with the window shut, fog between the panes, or a sash that sticks.
Each one points to a window that has stopped sealing. You're paying to heat and cool the outdoors through it.

We measure every opening, show you the window up close and order each one to fit. In older Wichita houses, we'll show you where two or three small windows could become one larger one: more light, fewer windows to buy.
Most homes are done in a day. Our energy efficient windows carry a manufacturer's lifetime warranty, from glass breakage to how the window opens and closes.
Casement, double hung, sliding, awning, hopper, picture, bay and basement windows.

image.alt: Sunlit living room with a large picture window and still sheer curtains
image.brief: sunlit living room with a large picture window on the right, sheer curtains hanging still, the room opening toward the left, calm neutral wall behind the text side, no readable text, no people

sections.quote: Our basement windows were so old and worn out that we could hear the neighbor dog barking like it was in our house. Our new windows were just installed and it is night and day different. We can't hear a PEEP! No dogs, no lawn mowers, no thunderstorms.. NOTHING!
sections.name: Ashley K.

sections.heading: Vinyl Siding
body: Siding takes the Kansas wind, hail and summer sun before anything else on the house does.
When it's worn out, you see it: faded or chalky panels, cracks, warped or melted spots, pieces the wind keeps loosening. What you don't see is the wall behind it, where gaps let in drafts and water.
We'll tell you straight whether yours has years left or is failing. If it was put up badly in the first place, patching it only buys time.
A siding consultation takes about an hour. We look at the whole house, talk through colors and styles, and give you the price. When the new siding goes up, the old siding leaves with us.

sections.quote: During the install, they pointed out a major issue with our siding—it was worn out, melted in spots, and poorly installed by the original builder. They didn't hesitate to walk us through the problem, explain our options clearly, and help us make the best long-term decision.
sections.name: Beth W.

sections.heading: Soffit and Fascia
body: Soffit and fascia are the boards under and along the edge of your roof. When they go soft or pull away, water gets behind the gutters and critters find a way into the attic.
We replace them along with your siding, so the whole edge of the house matches the new walls.

sections.heading: Sliding Patio Doors
body: An old sliding door is usually the leakiest opening in the house. The rollers wear out, the track bends, and the seal where the panels meet stops sealing.
You end up shoving it open with your shoulder and feeling the draft all winter. A new slider glides on new rollers and seals tight when it's closed.
We install it on its own or with your new windows, so the glass and frames match.

sections.quote: I now can open my sliding glass door with 1 finger instead of putting my whole body in it.
sections.name: Karla S.

sections.heading: One Project or One at a Time
body: Windows and siding meet at the trim around every opening. Do them together and the trim and caulk get finished once, the colors are chosen together, and one company handles the whole wall.
If the budget says windows this year and siding next year, that works too. Plenty of our customers do it in that order, and we'll plan so the second project fits the first.

sections.quote: I absolutely love my new windows, the guys were awesome, very professional and courteous. answered all my questions. I still love my windows every time I look at my house, Its beautiful. I have new siding and it really made my home beautiful, it's quieter, and is staying so much cooler.
sections.name: Melinda D.

items.title: We look at your house.
items.text: One of us comes out, measures and looks over what you want done. A window consultation takes about an hour and a half; siding takes about an hour. You see the products up close and get the price.

items.title: We order your materials.
items.text: Windows are built to your measurements, so plan on a few weeks. We give you the install date when you order.

items.title: Our crew does the work.
items.text: We show up in the morning and cover and protect your house and yard first. When we're done, we haul away the old windows, siding and trash.

items.title: We check back.
items.text: Before we leave, we walk you through the finished job. Then one of us follows up to make sure everything is right.

sections.heading: Wichita, Oklahoma City and 150 Miles Around
body: We have a hub in each city and work within 150 miles of both.
On the Kansas side that includes Haysville, Derby, Mulvane, El Dorado, McPherson, Salina and Emporia. In Oklahoma it includes Edmond, Yukon, Guthrie and Ponca City. Call the office closest to you.

items.a: Yes, for windows, siding and patio doors.

items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: Most window jobs are finished in a day. Bigger ones may need a second morning for trim and caulk. Siding depends on the size of the house, and you get the schedule at your consultation.

items.q: Should I do windows and siding at the same time?
items.a: If both need it, doing them together means the trim around each window is finished once and everything matches. If the budget points to one at a time, start with whichever is costing you more in comfort or energy. That's usually the windows.

items.q: What if I get a lower quote?
items.a: Bring it to us. If it's for a comparable product, we'll beat it.
Yes, including low-to-no-interest options. Ask about it at your consultation.

sections.heading: Older Homes and Crooked Openings
body: **Old houses rarely have square openings, and we fit them anyway.** We work each new window into the frame and trim you already have, then finish the edges so the room looks clean.
That goes for upper floors and storm-damaged openings too, not just the easy ground-floor windows.

sections.heading: Fewer, Larger Windows Where They Fit
body: Older houses often have lots of small windows. When we measure, we look for openings where one larger window can take the place of two or three small ones. The house looks cleaner from the street, and you have fewer windows to buy and install, which can take a real bite out of the cost of the job.

sections.quote: Our house originally had 34 windows, and Anthony was able to make it so that we would only need 17 windows to replace the whole house.

sections.heading: Cooler Rooms and Less Noise

footer.about: We're a locally owned and operated exterior remodeling company with hubs in Wichita and Oklahoma City. We replace windows, install vinyl siding and put in sliding patio doors.
why: Manufacturer's lifetime warranty on energy efficient windows
We beat a lower price on a comparable product

Your customers already make your case. You hold a 5.0 on 140 Google reviews, and they say it plainly: "Small company with owner involvement." "My house is much quieter and cooler now." "If you are looking into getting new windows call Evolve Exteriors first!"
Your website hides all of it behind sample text, and its phone buttons reach neither office.
So we built this site around their words.
strategy.cardsHeading: Be the Exterior Company People Find on Google
strategy.cardsIntro: Each card is one page: what your site does today and what we changed.

cards.title: Homepage
cards.why: The page Google reads to learn who you are and where you work.
problems: Every call button dials 1234567890, so a visitor who taps your Wichita number reaches nothing.
The Oklahoma City number is plain text with no button, so your second office can't be reached by tap.
The top of the page says "Best Professional Window Installation" with no town, so Google can't tell you work in Wichita.
Your 140 reviews are missing; the only quote is sample text from "Samantha Johnson".
fixes: Wichita and Oklahoma City are each one tap to call, on every page.
A headline that says exterior remodeling company in Wichita, KS, right at the top.
Real reviews from your customers, each beside the point it proves.
cards.alsoAdd: Hourly speed monitoring that keeps your site fast for visitors on phones, and speed is something Google uses to rank you.

cards.title: Window Replacement
cards.why: Windows are about three quarters of your written reviews, and they have no real page.
problems: "Our Windows" is eight style names with nothing on warranty, price or install, so Google has little to rank and shoppers little reason to call.
fixes: A full page for window replacement in Wichita, KS: styles, warranty, price match and install day.
Reviews on basement windows, old houses and cooler rooms, each beside its point.
cards.alsoAdd: Pages planned from what Google actually shows for each search, so every page targets something people really look for.

cards.title: Vinyl Siding
cards.why: Your crews finish siding in a day, and siding has no real page.
problems: "Vinyl Siding" opens a leftover page called "copy-of-our-windows": one siding paragraph, then window text ending mid-sentence on "that fit your."
fixes: A full page for vinyl siding in Wichita, KS, and the siding button opens it.
Your siding reviews beside the work they describe.
cards.alsoAdd: A check of what your competitors offer, so services you didn't think to mention still get their own pages.

cards.title: Contact
cards.why: Where a ready customer reaches you, at either office.
problems: "Get a Free Estimate", "Get a Quote" and "About Us" all lead back to the homepage.
The email link writes to info@mysite.com, a stranger's address.
fixes: Both numbers one tap away, with your hours and your real email.
A short list of what to have ready before you call.
cards.alsoAdd: Call and form tracking that shows which pages and towns your leads come from.

onboardingQuestions: Colton's and Riley's surnames, and how they want to be introduced on the site (the Thumbtack name "Helton" is unconfirmed).
Which phone number should lead on the site for Oklahoma City customers, and do they want the OKC number shown in the header as well as the footer and contact page?

Is there a street address to show? Only an unopened Angi snippet gives 2733 E. Kite Ct., Wichita; the Google profile shows 7804 E Funston St #208, Wichita. Which is current, and is there an OKC address?

Full list of services: entry doors, egress windows, basement windows beyond two reviews, bay and picture windows, soffit and fascia (one owner reply and a few reviews). Triple-pane windows (the blog and one review mention them)?
Window brand they install. "Wallside's Awning Windows" is the only name on the site and we could not confirm a dealer relationship, so no brand is named.
Does the manufacturer's lifetime warranty transfer to the next owner, and are the windows made in the USA? Only one review says so.
Years in business: the site says 5+ years in the industry, reviews start March 2025. What can we say?
Licensing, insurance, BBB or any certification to verify and show. None is stated anywhere we found.
Is financing through a named lender, and may we say "low-to-no interest"? The financing page also names the wrong city (Addison).
Should the 15% off sign-up offer on the current homepage be honored on the new site?
Typical install times for windows and siding, and what is included in the window, siding and patio door consultations, so the steps can be firmed up.
Logo file and brand colors (not sampled; none held in our files).
Is Evolve Egress and Exteriors (named in one review and on Angi) the same company?
